relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: In aged mice, RAMP1 expression in the SDH consistently increased after CCI

relationships.subject: RAMP1
relationships.evidence_quote: The decreased RAMP1 expression resulted in impaired CGRP signalling, while continuous elevation of RAMP1 led to excessive CGRP signalling.

relationships.subject: RAMP1
relationships.evidence_quote: The aged mice with CCI experienced significant pain relief 3 weeks after viral injection

key_findings: Spinal RAMP1 is reduced with age but increased after CCI in aged mice; RAMP1 shRNA knockdown reduced pain sensitivity and CCI allodynia and blunted CGRP responses.
